title: Service Desk Cover, Response Targets and Account Management by Programme Tier
content:
Hours of desk cover, the minutes within which a first response is targeted, the share of the monthly subscription credited where that target is missed, the assignment of a named account manager, the holding of a formal quarterly business review and the training sessions of a contract year are each published for every tier of the Corporate Travel Programmes.

The columns below carry the six tiers of the Corporate Travel Programmes in rank order: the Business Starter Programme, the Business Team Programme, the Business Pro Programme, the Business Enterprise Programme, the Business Enterprise Plus Programme and the Business Global Programme.

|  | Starter | Team | Pro | Enterprise | Enterprise Plus | Global |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Hours a day the service desk is staffed | 10 | 12 | 16 | 24 | 24 | 24 |
| Minutes within which a first response is targeted | 480 | 240 | 120 | 60 | 30 | 15 |
| Share of the monthly subscription credited when the target is missed | 0 per cent | 0 per cent | 5 per cent | 10 per cent | 15 per cent | 20 per cent |
| Named account manager assigned | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Formal quarterly business review held | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Training sessions included each contract year | 0 | 1 | 2 | 4 | 8 | 12 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. Desk cover runs 10 hours a day on the Business Starter Programme, 12 on the Business Team Programme and 16 on the Business Pro Programme; the Business Enterprise Programme, the Business Enterprise Plus Programme and the Business Global Programme are each staffed 24 hours a day.
2. The first-response target tightens across the tiers from 480 minutes through 240, 120, 60 and 30 to 15 minutes.
3. The service credit published against a missed target is 0 per cent on the Business Starter Programme and the Business Team Programme, then 5 per cent, 10 per cent, 15 per cent and 20 per cent of the monthly subscription across the four tiers above them.
4. A named account manager and a formal quarterly business review belong to the Business Enterprise Programme and the two tiers above it.
5. Training sessions for the company's travellers run 0 in the Business Starter Programme's contract year, then 1, 2, 4, 8 and 12 across the tiers above it.
